stops.title: The queues
stops.caption: First-timers, no group, and overdue.
stops.speech: Follow-ups has three queues: first-timers nobody has contacted yet, people in no group at all, and contacts that are now overdue.

stops.title: Logging one
stops.caption: Who, how, and what happens next.
stops.speech: Logging a follow-up records who reached out, how, what happened, and what should happen next. It can be flagged as a concern too.
